title: Snowshoes and Their Uses, in Spalding’s Winter Sports
version: 1917 chapter transcribed by Hudson River Maritime Museum, 14 January 2022
lineage: The museum transcription was inspected, not the printed book. This is an attributed researcher paraphrase. The historic text contains harmful racial stereotypes that are not adopted.

passages.note: Paragraphs on wooden bows, hide webbing and snowshoes sold by leading dealers in large cities.
